name: Team Rocket Grunt
title: Team Rocket
dialogue: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You’re challenging me to a battle? Hah! You’re nuts, but you have guts! I like that! If you can beat me, I’ll tell you a password to the boss’s room!
The password for the boss’s door-- RATICATETAIL. But if you don’t have both passwords... Ha ha ha!
